title: Sleep feeling hard to land?
caption: Feeling jittery and sleepy at the same time? The sky is calm and steady today, so there’s more room to recoup while patterns settle. Take slow breaths and one light stretch, and step outside for a bit of daylight to set your pace.
snapshot: Space conditions are quiet and even. Solar wind looks normal and there are no notable solar bursts reported. A slight southward tilt is present, more like static than a shove. Overall, it’s a gentler backdrop.
affects: Some may notice less push and more room to recharge. Wired and tired at once can still pop up while patterns settle. Sensitivity may linger for those catching up, especially if local weather is busy.
playbook:
- Take slow breaths and one light stretch
- Step outside for a bit of daylight
- Hydrate and keep caffeine earlier
- Keep screens softer and sounds lower later

fb.caption: Sleep feeling hard to land? That jittery-and-sleepy-at-once mix can still pop up. The sky’s calm and steady today, which gives your system more room to recoup while patterns settle—think volume turned down, not off. Sensitivity may still linger, especially if your local weather is busy. Pace gently: take slow breaths, do one light stretch, step outside for a bit of daylight to set your rhythm. Hydrate, keep caffeine earlier, and soften screens and sounds later. Are you feeling more wired-and-tired today, or is the extra room to recharge starting to show up?
